string.name: name
string.value: Lv. 30 Weapon Bypass Key

string.name: desc
string.value: Drag the #cBypass Key# into an equip window slot (#chotkey E#) to equip weapons that are for #cup to 30 levels# above yours for #c30 days#. \nYou may not stack #cBypass Keys of other levels#. Characters with the #cEmpress's Might# skill may not use Bypass Keys. Can only be used on equipment.\n#c Available slots: Weapon, shield, secondary weapon#

string.name: name
string.value: Wheel of Destiny

string.name: desc
string.value: Brings you back to the current map when your character is resurrected. Cannot be used in some party quests, event maps, and vehicles (boats).

string.name: name
string.value: Revival Stone

string.name: desc
string.value: Revives the character on the spot without a decrease in EXP or equip durability. Restores Hp and mp by 100% and gives special boost at a set rate. Disappears when used.
